required_observations: the exact ServiceAccount can be read
RoleBinding and ClusterRoleBinding subjects are compared separately
IRSA annotation presence is reported without exposing the role ARN
Pod Identity associations are summarized by namespace and ServiceAccount
EKS access entries are summarized without principal ARN or account ID

partial_observation.optional_eks_reads: continue other layers; report list-operation totals separately from successful describes, require access-entry describe and associated-policy list success for completeness, and aggregate redacted detail failure counts/reasons
partial_observation.denied_read: not observed; never interpreted as an absent relationship

non_claims: a relationship does not prove effective permission
missing monitoring data alone does not prove AccessDenied
this package grants no learner permission and creates no Section resource

cleanup.phase_one: remove only the exact Section observation directory and preserve the governed common identity
cleanup.phase_two: run common delete.sh then common post-guard-verify.sh; only the governed verifier may remove identity after exact Account/Arn/UserId byte and residual revalidation
